topic: Your gas pedal feels heavy or slow to bounce back? Here's what that means.
negativePromptStanding: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.label: HOOK
beats.narration: Your gas pedal feels heavy, or slow to bounce back when you let off?
beats.visualPrompt: Close macro shot of a gas pedal at rest in a car's footwell, warm interior lighting, static-mounted camera, shallow depth of field, slightly slow push-in.

beats.label: SYMPTOM
beats.narration: Not dramatic — just... sluggish. Like it's fighting you a little.
beats.visualPrompt: Cutaway to an engine-bay shot: a throttle body assembly in soft focus, visible grime/residue on the intake-side edge, subtle steam/heat shimmer.

beats.label: EXPLANATION
beats.narration: One clue: buildup on the throttle body can make the pedal feel stiff — a cheap fix.
beats.visualPrompt: Macro/cutaway shot: an inspection light angled onto the throttle-body bore, revealing carbon buildup texture in contrast light; slow rack focus from clean edge to buildup.

beats.label: CONSEQUENCE
beats.narration: But a pedal that sticks — not just feels heavy — can point to a cable or sensor problem instead.
beats.visualPrompt: Wide shot from a driver's-eye POV (dash and windshield only, no driver) on an open road, subtle camera shake suggesting an unpredictable, uneven acceleration feel.

beats.label: SAFE_ACTION
beats.narration: Don't guess which one you've got. That's not something to wait on.
beats.visualPrompt: Diagnostic-scanner close-up: a handheld OBD-II scan tool mounted near the dash port, generic gauge graphics on screen, shop bay softly blurred behind.

beats.label: BRANDED_CTA
beats.narration: Worth checking either way. Stop by and we'll take a look. Nick's Tire & Auto.
beats.visualPrompt: Branded end-card plate: Nick's Tire & Auto shop bay wide shot, warm daylight, static hold. Logo/CTA text composited in post, not generated.
